# Dameng JDBC Driver

This directory stores local runtime driver assets used by the enterprise identity provider.

- `DmJdbcDriver18-8.1.2.192.jar`: Dameng JDBC driver used by `agentseek.enterprise.identity.jdbc_driver`.

The jar was extracted from the local `ai-bot/wecom-oa-robot` Spring Boot artifact for Mac development. In production, prefer the official `dmpython` / `dmPython` driver on Linux, or replace this jar with the version approved by the enterprise platform team.
